thread:
tess-hiringmgr: Need quick guidance. Candidate accepted verbal but needs earlier start (03/30) because their lease overlap is paid. Requesting L3->L4 comp-band uplift + $8k sign-on, plus a one-time equity top-up (5% of FY grant) to match counteroffer. Can we expedite? cc @li-peopleops @ron-recruiter
li-peopleops: Please upload the market comp snapshot + manager justification. Equity top-ups require legal sign-off if above standard grant size. Also note payroll cutoff: 2026-03-25 for 3/30 start to hit first pay. Benefits effective date window depends on hire date; confirm preferred benefits start.
ron-recruiter: Uploaded the comp CSV and candidate note: prefers 03/30. Counteroffer includes $10k sign-on + 0% equity top-up. Manager proposes $8k + 5% top-up. Link: https://redwood.internal/hiring/candidates/282987
comp-committee: Acknowledge. For band uplift we need peer comp table and a short retention plan. Equity top-ups are reviewed by compensation & legal. Submit as OP-2026-144 so we can route. Chair can triage if you mark expedited.
tess-hiringmgr: Short retention bullets: 1) project milestone completion at 6 months with $10k retention bonus; 2) 1-year cliff removal condition if meet Q4 target. Adding to packet now.
li-peopleops: Reminder: any sign-on > $5k triggers finance GL review. For equity, legal requires candidate acceptance before grant issuance. If you want front-loaded equity, we need exec sign-off.
ron-recruiter: Filed OP-2026-144 and requested expedite. Candidate needs written offer by EOD.
finance-approvals: Finance reviewed prelim numbers. We can split sign-on 60/40 across first two payrolls if preferred. GL code will be assigned once OP number is final.
comp-committee: Chair flagged pay-equity risk but accepts case with conditions: (a) cap uplift to L4 midpoint, (b) equity top-up limited to 4% FY grant instead of 5%, (c) add 6-month comp review. Exception code EXC-COMP-2026-11 if approved.
li-peopleops: Legal has a question about cliff removal language. @tess-hiringmgr please confirm acceptance terms for equity acceleration clause. Keep it to performance-based milestones only.
tess-hiringmgr: Confirmed: acceleration tied to milestone completion at 6 months only. No unconditional cliff change.
comp-committee: Final: approved with modified equity (4%) and sign-on $8k split 60/40. Exception EXC-COMP-2026-11 issued. Please include in HRIS notes and tag for 6-month review.
onboard-bot: Offer Created: ID OP-2026-144  Status: approved (exception EXC-COMP-2026-11).
ron-recruiter: Sending offer now. Candidate start set to 2026-03-30 per manager and payroll cutoff. Benefits enrollment window noted; benefits effective 2026-05-01 per system if onboarding steps completed.
li-peopleops: Closing loop: added exception code to HRIS and scheduled 6-month comp review task. :white_check_mark:
tess-hiringmgr: Thanks all 389 — will update once candidate signs.
